parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description: The user ID of the API caller.

parameters.name: TableGuid
parameters.description:
The GUID of the table in DMS.

> - For a logical database, call the [ListLogicTables](~~141875~~) operation and set the ReturnGuid parameter to true.
>
> - For a physical database, call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation and set the ReturnGuid parameter to true.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.

> You can find the tenant ID by hovering over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
